text:
Marta: Heads-up — vendor OrionEdge reported a pre-deploy firmware regression; customs flagged the shipment and they're holding 12 EU racks at staging. This will block the SI integration and the marketplace onboarding we planned for next week.
Jason: can you paste the vendor ticket/ETA? we need to see if Dedicated commitments are impacted.
Marta: ticket #OR-4521 — vendor comment: 'awaiting signed test cert from partner QA', ETA ~72h but could slip. Link: https://partners.orionedge.com/t/4521
Linh: 72h would put us past the marketplace listing date. Recommend we pause the joint announcement and shift staging. @Oliver — what's SI's go/no-go?
Oliver: can't finish E2E without that firmware. Our tests rely on the KV cache behavior change in the new image. Can we run smoke on 2 racks with older fw as a fallback?
Marta: vendor warns older fw has different kernel flags and perf variance. Could cause false negatives. Sachin, do we have inventory to swap 2 racks from another pool?
Sachin: small buffer — 3 racks in US staging marked spare, but transit to EU is ~5 days. Not viable for next-week launch.
partners-bot: shipment-hold OR-4521 updated — status: 'awaiting QA sign-off' — ETA field set to 72h.
Jason: Proposed action list: 1) Pause public announcement; 2) Escalate to vendor RM for expedited QA sign-off; 3) Scope limited SI mock tests to validate core flows; 4) Notify affected Dedicated customers and adjust capacity allocations. Who owns customer comms?
Linh: I'll draft customer notifications for Dedicated and loop in marketplace owners. Oliver, can you scope mock harness tests and timeline?
Oliver: I'll try a mock KV/caching harness and run smoke on the remaining EU infra where possible. If we can validate core paths we might do a soft-launch with capacity caps. Will report by EOD.
Marta: I'll escalate to the partner RM and request a signed QA window and courier priority. Holding all joint PR assets until I confirm. :no_entry_sign:
Jason: Add updates to the incident doc and tag the oncall infra: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OR-4521
Linh: Added initial draft comms and a customer impact matrix. Ping me when the vendor confirms so I can send the notification. :eyes:
